input.title: OT not restarted (model id = 2133379243)

ground_truth.root_cause: Model's OT job hit its TMS TTL and expired (expired at 5pm UTC), putting it into TMSTrainingState.EXPIRED — a terminal state that blocks the MLHub UI restart button from transitioning to ONLINE. Skill lacked EXPIRED-state context since adhoc jobs began being registered. Workaround for QE: rerun the original fire cmd that started it. Skill update D101303813 added.

input.title: Can't restart online training — model 2129751166 in TMSTrainingState.EXPIRED
input.body: Workplace post: OT job for model 2129751166 was killed by TMS bot, clicking 'Restart Online Training' in MLHub UI fails with GraphQL error: 'Model 2129751166 in an invalid state: TMSTrainingState.EXPIRED for transition to LogicalTrainingState.ONLINE.' Model is in QE.

ground_truth.root_cause: For ~2 hours the OneFeed data stream went thin (sampling rate 0.3 + weight gating made the per-task slice tiny), so the window had zero clicks for the onefeed tasks. NE divides loss by entropy(CTR); when CTR→0 the entropy denominator collapses and NE blows up (14B) — a numerical artifact of the windowed metric on a starved/zero-click slice, not a true model-performance regression (lifetime NE is smooth).
ground_truth.verdict: resolved — explained as metric artifact (window starvation), not a real regression

input.title: Multi-Scribe Training NE spike: onefeed tasks showing NE 14B during 2-hour window
input.body: Training model 2125931050 with two scribes; onefeed tasks CTR spiked to 0 and NE reached 14B for 2 hours (7–9 PM), then returned to normal. Lifetime NE was smooth. Requesting guidance on whether this is a true regression or artifact of multi-scribe training.

ground_truth.root_cause: When adding a new embedding table (10→11 tables), the serving predictor's model_param_config in Manifold still reflects the old architecture. Delta updates require _get_model_param_config_for_sparse() (utils.py:641) to map all embedding FQNs to weight_ids; the new 11th table is missing from the predictor's config (written when it last loaded an old-model snapshot) → FQN→weight_id mapping fails → RuntimeError 'Expected 11, got 10'.
ground_truth.verdict: Check 8 aged out; root cause articulated, mitigation proposed not confirmed

Expected 11, got 10.' Checkpoint in Manifold contains the new table correctly.

ground_truth.root_cause: False positive. ODS dpp_worker.scribe_example_age_ms.avg.60 (~2.5 min) is correct ground truth; the model is healthy. The Scuba-derived column checkpoint_training_data_age_mins has two formula bugs for OT jobs: (1) timezone mismatch — metric_value is UTC but train_end_ts is shifted -7h via TIME_ZONE_CONVERTER, injecting systematic error (known bug D75703936); (2) wrong scope — the detector was designed for recurring training, not OT, where train_end_ts is hour-aligned via _resolve_ts_now().
ground_truth.p_row: CL-013 (training-age spike — this instance a false positive); novel pattern proposed

input.title: Inconsistent training example age: Scuba shows 3000min, ODS shows 2.5min for facebook_reels_vdd_hstu_v0 model 877766932
input.body: Alert fired showing ~3000 min training example age for facebook_reels_vdd_hstu_v0 (model 877766932). MAST ODS shows actual data age of ~2.5 min. Two metrics contradictory: Scuba-derived checkpoint_training_data_age_mins vs ODS dpp_worker.scribe_example_age_ms.

ground_truth.root_cause: SilverTorch STUS models use the GMPP publisher path (Scribe -> ZippyDB for metadata), which was blocked during S660017/S660220. In-trainer MVAI models write directly to model store, bypassing GMPP/Scribe, so they were unaffected. Differential impact is a known architectural vulnerability (P50).

input.title: STUS/SilverTorch models 2131554922, 877766818, 877767096 hit 0 QPS for ~7h during S660017/S660220 (May 6)
input.body: During S660017 (ZippyDB) / S660220 (Scribe data loss) on May 6, several MVAI models had 0 QPS for ~7 hours with no new snapshots and freshness violations. Models 2131554922, 877766818, 877767096 (STUS/SilverTorch) affected; model 877546696 (in-trainer MVAI) was not affected.

ground_truth.root_cause: Elastic agent error handling: when the job errored at 11pm, the elastic agent failed to propagate a non-zero exit code, so SJD did not detect the job as stuck and kill it. Job silently hung logging noise instead of cleaning up. Per Li Lu's analysis P2338625112 (related to P21).
ground_truth.owner: Max Kaplan (SEV S665478, owner Xingjia Ma)

input.title: OT Job mvai-training-online-2123154171 logged error at 11pm, hung 11 hours without cleanup
input.body: Job mvai-training-online-2123154171 (v0, attempt 0) logged a failure at 11pm but did not clean up — it silently hung logging noise until manually killed 11 hours later. SJD did not detect the job as stuck. Same issue recurred on mvai-training-online-2123153585.

ground_truth.root_cause: Expected RES behavior: enable_raw_embedding_streaming=True triggers SnapshotType.SPARSE_DELTA every res_streaming_interval_s=15s in training_ps_scheduler_process.py:447; RES and training publish paths are independent. False-alarm: monitoring conflated RES-path with training-path deltas.

input.title: ig_reels_tab_esr_ttsn OT test generating SPARSE_DELTAs at 3.3/min vs expected 1/6min for 1h17min
input.body: OT release test (model 2122065668) generating SPARSE_DELTAs at ~3.3/min — ~20x higher than expected rate of 1 per 6 min — during a 1h17min test run on 2026-05-21. Unexpected SPARSE_DELTA frequency raised concern about possible misconfiguration.

ground_truth.root_cause: Elastic-agent hang caused by SIGSEGV on rank 7 (C++ ServiceRouter stats callback); D-state ranks blocked TorchElastic from exiting; checkpoint v609 frozen at CREATING/size=0. Same mechanism as S667567 (elastic-agent, not Python GIL P44). Resolved by manual kill of v4 + TMS restart from v608.

input.title: FBR IFU I2I model 2132070936 missing FULL_SNAPSHOT 8+ hours — reranker 2125081901 hung since 04:27 PDT
input.body: Model 2132070936 (facebook_reels_ifu_i2i, PROD) has not published a FULL_SNAPSHOT for 8+ hours. Upstream reranker 2125081901 hung: MAST reports RUNNING but last mvai_metrics at 04:27 PDT, checkpoint v609 stuck in CREATING (size=0) since 04:29 PDT.

ground_truth.root_cause: ACL access not provisioned for msgr_eng_product_intelligence_temp and videorecs_reels_private_sharing oncalls to commit in the relevant code path and preserve an ephemeral app-layer package. Resolved by creating + approving ACL tasks T273490223 and T273490053.

input.title: ACL access needed to convert ephemeral app-layer package for msgr_eng_product_intelligence_temp and videorecs_reels_private_sharing
input.body: Two oncalls need ACL access to commit and preserve an ephemeral app-layer package. Attempting to follow the MVAI package preservation guide but blocked by missing permissions. Affects msgr_eng_product_intelligence_temp and videorecs_reels_private_sharing packages.

ground_truth.root_cause: Bias explosion in embedding_feature_modules.linear_modules.2 layer during training (sudden abnormal bias-parameter surge), driven by rare data conditions plus insufficient model-level safeguards (no gradient clipping). MSV was set to alert_only and did not block the bad snapshot.
ground_truth.verdict: mitigated (revert to snapshot 347; gradient clipping prevents recurrence)

input.title: IG Stories Model 875799562 (ig_stories_tray_mtml baseline) — impacted recommendation metrics and training NEs
input.body: L3 SEV. IG Stories MTML model 875799562 experienced sharp NE spike (training NEX) during publish of snapshot 349, causing recommendation metric degradation. Up to 5% drop on topline Stories metrics from 1/5 2:30PM ET to 1/6 2:00AM ET. MSV set to alert_only and did not block the bad snapshot.

ground_truth.root_cause: A change between light_cli v4535 -> 4539 triggered a py-spy process to enter a state where it consumes its core and stops responding to TERM signals. The trainer sends TERM to py-spy during shutdown and waits for graceful exit; py-spy's hang prevents the trainer from exiting. (py-spy hang itself not root-caused; tool being deprecated.)
ground_truth.verdict: mitigated (disable py-spy JK for all MVAI; D94098324 adds TERM->KILL after 15s)

input.title: [Silvertorch][MVAI] Jobs not shutting down correctly — publish hangs for 9+ hours across IFR T2I, ESR, IGR T2I
input.body: L3 SEV. SilverTorch/MVAI publish jobs complete all steps but MAST job continues to idle/hang for several hours before timing out. Affects silvertorch/ifr_prospector, silvertorch/ifr_t2i, silvertorch/ifr_umia_v1, mvai/mvai_ig_ranking. Trunk broken for T2I and ESR conveyors.

ground_truth.root_cause: The publish subprocess crashed at dlopen time: two CUDA libraries (fbr/flash and ads_mkl) both register the same fbgemm::fmha_bwd operator (Blackwell FMHA backward defined in two .cu files both linked into the publish binary) - a build/packaging conflict. The parent process had no subprocess liveness detection, so it blocked on message_queue.get() until Gloo timeout.
ground_truth.verdict: self-resolved; prevention D96387953 adds is_alive() liveness check

input.title: [mvai/video_udd_lsr] online_train_publish step fails w/ StuckJobException — conveyor blocked 6.5 days
input.body: L3 SEV. Conveyor mvai/video_udd_lsr blocked at cogwheel step for ~6.5 days. Online training publish subprocess crashing at dlopen time; parent process blocked on message_queue.get() until Gloo timeout triggers StuckJobException. 24 consecutive failures (R4473–R4571).

ground_truth.root_cause: D96993922 (a fragment-migration distillery refactor) extracted ranking_logger creation from async_rank_media into helper _create_lsr_ranking_logger_and_log, but the helper did not return ranking_logger, so it stayed None in the main flow. The downstream _async_log_training_data call (guarded by 'if ranking_logger is not None') was silently skipped, halting training-data logging to Scribe/Muddler for Feed, TIXU, Search. No alert monitored training-data write volume during Django pushes.
ground_truth.verdict: mitigated (revert D98295929, blocklist corrupted window, ban snapshots, restart OT)

input.title: Threads Online Training Data Breakage — training data volume near zero for Feed, TIXU, Search ~9 hours
input.body: L1 SEV. Threads Feed, TIXU, and Search ranking path training data volume dropped to near zero for ~9 hours after D96993922 landed at ~4:35 AM EST. ESR, LSR, and VM MTML models began showing NE/calibration drift. Engagement metric regressions: Likes ~6.5%, Impressions ~4.7%, Reshare ~9.5%.

ground_truth.root_cause: Known model problem where the optimizer state becomes worse over time, which triggers an NE explosion (bad optimizer status). See N10312608.

input.title: Stories Secondary MTML model 877553271 NE spike — elevated for 4 hours during PB1 launch
input.body: L3 SEV. Secondary MTML model 877553271 NE elevated for 4 hours; detected via model calibration alerts. Incident occurred during PB1 launch period. Expected holdout impact on time spent and impression mixshift. Model reached unstable state requiring snapshot revert.

ground_truth.root_cause: DPP rolled out D100836039, intended to apply training-data age capping only to models with QPS throttling, but by mistake it applied to all tier-3 and tier-4 models — so train examples older than 5 minutes were discarded for all QE models. The diff was rolled back and affected jobs restarted to pick up the fix.

input.title: Threads Retrieval Models OT Example Age Capped — examples older than 5 min discarded for tier-3/4
input.body: L3 SEV. From April 13, Main and X-App U2M QE models (tier 3 and 4) had training examples capped by data age — examples older than 5 minutes were discarded if the job restarted. Caused unreliable QE metric readings for ~2 days.

ground_truth.root_cause: A single bad AMD task in SCU region (tsp_scu/ipnext_ip_prod/deployment.partition.default_amd_mi300xg1.m2143272283_slatest/2) throwing runtime errors. Infra failure; the bad task was automatically removed, resolving the issue.

input.title: Model 2143272283 (threads_feed_mtml experimental) inference error rate ~87% in SCU from a bad AMD task
input.body: L3 SEV. Model 2143272283 experienced ~87% error rate in SCU region due to a single bad AMD task. Other regions remained healthy; overall error rate ~2.5%. Non-prod experimental model.

ground_truth.root_cause: Genuine capacity shortfall — entitlement fb_reels_prod_online_h100 oversubscribed (8+ OT jobs sharing quota), causing a preemption cascade (SCRIBE overload, fragmented capacity, high demand). Continued PENDING despite available quota aligned with S658149's GPU quota split. Scribe overquota hypothesis eliminated (not enforced at tenant level). Mitigated when Keehwan Park killed and re-queued the job May 1.
ground_truth.p_row: P10 (preemption cascade via oversubscribed entitlement); P39 FALSIFIED; CL-006

input.title: [MVAI] Online training job for model 883552231 (facebook_reels_ifu_mtml_v0) stuck in PENDING 6+ hours
input.body: L3 SEV. Model 883552231 MAST training job stuck in PENDING; 23 failed attempts recorded with preemption errors (SCRIBE overload, fragmented capacity). No snapshots published for 6+ hours. Entitlement fb_reels_prod_online_h100 shared by 8+ OT jobs.

ground_truth.root_cause: ml_deps_graph retention leak holding 194 archived light_cli versions un-deletable, exhausting the fbpkg version cap; structural recurring failure (cap increases palliative, not curative)

input.title: light_cli fbpkg at 800/800 version cap — recurrence of S657811 blocking mvai_ifr_main, silvertorch/ifr_umia_v1
input.body: L4 SEV. mvai/light_cli fbpkg hit 800/800 version cap at ~01:20 PT May 11 (~6.2h duration, detected 05:44 PT). 303 archived versions consuming cap. Blocked: mvai_ifr_main, silvertorch/ifr_umia_v1, fire-app-fbr-preranker, video_ifu_lsr. Second recurrence within 7 days.

ground_truth.root_cause: PyTorch upstream diff D104838289 introduced a TorchScript annotation mismatch in torch.unique_consecutive: torch/functional.py:_consecutive_return_inverse_and_counts annotated as returning Tuple[Tensor] but actually returns Tuple[Tensor,Tensor,Tensor]; caught at TorchScript packaging, failing publish_multi_forward. Call chain via li_cluster_selection_op.py:_select_clusters.

input.title: [mvai/umia_v1_igr] IGR Tab T2I publish blocked by PyTorch unique_consecutive JIT annotation mismatch
input.body: L4 SEV. mvai/umia_v1_igr Conveyor blocked at publish_multi_forward step since 2026-05-13 19:42 UTC. TorchScript packaging step fails deterministically due to type annotation mismatch in torch.unique_consecutive. Releases R11393.2 and R11409.1 both failed.

ground_truth.root_cause: CUDACachingAllocator free_block assertion triggered rank 0 SIGABRT; elastic agent raised ChildFailedError to light.py main(), which had no try/except on the error path; Python shutdown attempted to join NCCL communicator threads stuck waiting on dead rank 0 → join blocks forever → process zombie; MAST never read reply file. Fixed by D98638473 (wraps main() try/except → os._exit()); base layer predated fix by 19 days

input.title: Threads Retrieval U2M OT jobs get stuck sporadically — zombie process no self-recovery (model 2124793203)
input.body: L3 SEV. Threads Retrieval U2M OT job mvai-training-online-2124793203 gets stuck sporadically; MAST reports RUNNING but process is a zombie — no new checkpoints, no mvai_metrics updates. Manual kill required for each occurrence. Affects feed_u2m model type.

ground_truth.root_cause: Sandcastle OOM on I7_XLARGE workers during buck2 x86 compilation of light_cli; oomd kills x86 builds while aarch64/amd64 complete fine. No code change triggered it — chronic capacity mismatch between light_cli build memory requirements and Sandcastle worker limits.

input.title: mvai/light_cli conveyor blocked: fbpkg Build Node failing ~11h — Sandcastle OOM on I7_XLARGE workers
input.body: L4 SEV. mvai/light_cli fbpkg Build Node failing since R39595.1 from 09:30–20:28 PT May 18 (~11h). Sandcastle OOM kills on I7_XLARGE workers during buck2 x86 compilation. No new trunk releases shipping during window. Chronic recurrence of S648404.

ground_truth.root_cause: REAL_OT_FAILURE — recurring daily trainer crash on CFR main mtml recipe; crash correlated with the same scribe quota pressure cluster as S668542 (Feed scribe quota 2.797 TB/s vs 2.66 TB/s cap). QA-tier, low priority.

input.title: CFR main mtml (m2122688235) daily trainer crash — QA-tier OT job crashing daily for 7 days
input.body: cfr_main_feed_mtml_roo_hstu QA-tier OT job (m2122688235) crashing daily; SEV open 2026-05-22 to 2026-05-29 (7 days). QA-tier model freshness degraded throughout the incident window. Recurring daily crash pattern.

ground_truth.root_cause: SIGSEGV on rank 7 (C++ ServiceRouter stats callback) → D-state workers blocked the elastic agent → zombie job with no self-recovery. (Initial triage misclassified as P44 GIL hang; corrected to elastic-agent hang.)
ground_truth.verdict: mitigated (manual kill, TMS restart from checkpoint v608)

input.title: FBR I2I reranker 2125081901 SIGSEGV hang — FULL_SNAPSHOT on downstream model 2132070936 stalled 28h
input.body: Reranker model 2125081901 stopped training at 04:27 PDT May 23; MAST reports RUNNING but last mvai_metrics at that time, checkpoint v609 stuck in CREATING (size=0). Downstream ST model 2132070936 had no FULL_SNAPSHOT for ~28h. Elastic agent not recovering.

ground_truth.root_cause: IPNext releases blocked by S668184 (TW Controller Timeouts). Both models (m2129445831 + m2144714031) are FBLearner batch models with no MAST OT job; serving-stage only, not OT pipeline (R18 T4 serving-stage drop). Resolved after S668184 cleared IPNext release blockage.

input.title: TIFU ESR Primary & Secondary models stuck loading snapshot — IPNext releases blocked
input.body: Prod TIFU ESR Primary and Secondary models (ig_textpost_tifu_esr + ig_textpost_tifu_m2m_retrieval) stuck loading snapshot. IPNext releases blocked due to TW Controller Timeouts from S668184. Serving degradation during snapshot loading failures.

ground_truth.root_cause: D106415488 removed -mavx2 compiler flags from deeplearning/fbgemm/fbgemm_gpu/fb/BUCK (128-line change), breaking fbpkg build at light_cli build node. Fix: D106415488 reverted or -mavx2 flag restored.

input.title: mvai/light_cli conveyor blocked: fbpkg Build Node failing since R39595.1 — ~6h no trunk releases
input.body: mvai/light_cli fbpkg Build Node failing since R39595.1 (last green R39594.1, created 2026-05-27 11:00 PDT); ~6h conveyor block. No new trunk releases shipping; model freshness degrading across all downstream light_cli dependents.

ground_truth.root_cause: Transient infra noise (TRANSIENT_NOISE, auto-resolved); no persistent OT job failure; likely upstream publish delay self-cleared. Snapshot freshness restored by 10:29 PT.

input.title: MC11 model 2143912626 snapshot stale — SEV opened 09:27 PT, mitigated within ~1h
input.body: MC11 milestone snapshot for model 2143912626 went stale; SEV opened 09:27 PT May 28. Snapshot freshness alert triggered. SEV mitigated 10:29 PT and closed 11:16 PT.

ground_truth.root_cause: TMS bot incorrectly blocked the streaming job; MAST OT job was RUNNING within 12 min and self-recovered (auto-resolved without operator intervention).

input.title: ESR Integrity TTSN streaming inference job blocked by TMS bot (igwb-relevance) ~38 min
input.body: ESR Integrity TTSN streaming inference job (igwb-relevance) blocked by smart training platform bot at 13:15 PDT May 29. Kill message from smart__ai_infra__training_management_system.s3. Stale embeddings risked degraded IG content moderation quality during the ~38-min outage.

ground_truth.root_cause: Double downsampling regression introduced after R11789.2 caused publish_multi_forward to exceed memory in the publish step, blocking Conveyor. Fix: double downsampling corrected.

input.title: IGR Tab T2I Conveyor publish validation blocked ~5 days — publish_multi_forward OOM from R11789.2
input.body: mvai/umia_v1_igr Conveyor publish validation blocked for ~5 days starting 2026-05-30. publish_multi_forward step OOM'd from release R11789.2, preventing all new trunk releases from completing validation. All IGR Tab T2I new model releases blocked.

input.title: generate-job-config-diff not work?
input.body: mvai online-training-mgr generate-job-config-diff -m 2119446895 failed with 'Error message: Uncaught exception executing PREPARE'. Command failing continuously when trying to generate OT config for model 2119446895. Asking for help to mitigate.

ground_truth.root_cause: Transient configerator write failure ('Uncaught exception executing PREPARE') in mvai online-training-mgr generate-job-config-diff code path; D108337795 adds automatic retries to prevent future CLI failures from the same cause.

input.title: MLHub showing incorrect MAST job for model
input.body: In MLHub for model 2123804366 (threads_feed_mtml), the Online Training section displays an incorrect MAST job (pni_mb4_fresh). GraphQL query confirms the wrong job is returned for this model. Is this a metadata issue?

ground_truth.root_cause: MLHub/AIM queries MAST job by model_type instead of model_id, returning the first entry matching that type. Model 2123804366 (threads_feed_mtml) returns pni_mb4_fresh — the first MAST job of that type — instead of the correct OT job. Fix: D107935047 corrects the query to filter by model_id.

input.title: [Online Training] Silent streaming publisher failure — root model snapshots frozen 22h+
input.body: 3 root models (2121054758, 2120474184, 2120929351) affected: OT MAST jobs show RUNNING but root_model_snapshot_id has been frozen for 18-22+ hours. ST publish continues but republishes stale root checkpoints. Production QE traffic GR source rate dropped ~50% across affected arms (v5_4 arm1: 9.28%→4.05%; arm2: 8.42%→3.45%; arm3: 8.48%→3.47%; v5_3 arm6: 9.29%→4.05%). One model (2121054758) partially self-recovered.

ground_truth.root_cause: P61 zombie trainer: worker hit CUDACachingAllocator assertion error; pre-D98638473 base layer fails to exit cleanly after ChildFailedError; NCCL communicator threads block in threading._shutdown(); MAST never detects failure despite retries available. Same root cause as S665454 and S670887. Manual kill required; long-term fix: upgrade base layer to include D98638473.

input.title: Online train kept failing and delta track config not being populated
input.body: OT model 2121486280 (ig_textpost_feed_esr) kept failing. Delta tracker config shows three embedding tables (media_embedding_cache, always_on_media_id, always_on_author_id) missing from skip_embedding_table_names in the mvai train config. Job fails with torch.cat() expecting a non-empty list of Tensors on restart.

ground_truth.root_cause: Duplicate sparse streaming config specified in both trainer_config and delta_publish_config — a long-standing tech debt in the model config (model-side, not OT infra). Fix applied via D107578770.

input.title: [Help Needed] MC12 arm3 OT — training example age over 1 hour
input.body: MC12 arm3 OT job (mvai-training-online-2123944781) has training example age over 1 hour; target is below 2 minutes. DPP starvation check shows 0% starvation.

ground_truth.root_cause: Peak-traffic capacity shortfall: trainer at 10x8 GPUs cannot keep up with peak scribe data rate. DPP-bound eliminated (0% starvation confirms trainer-bound). Scribe backlog causes example age to spike during peak periods. Mitigation: scale trainers from 10x8 to 16x8 or 20x8, or subsample data.

input.title: [Action needed] OT job for ig_textpost_feed_u2m_retrieval become zombie - need manual kill and patch the diff
input.body: OT job mvai-training-online-2124793203 stuck — training QPS has been at 0 since 09:39. Job shows RUNNING in MAST but is no longer training. A worker hit a CUDACachingAllocator assertion error; MAST shows no new attempt created despite 100 retries available.

ground_truth.root_cause: P61: CUDACachingAllocator assertion error on one worker → ChildFailedError raised to light.py main() → pre-D98638473 base layer (light_cli:5308, upstream 2026-05-02) has no clean exit path → falls through to threading._shutdown() → NCCL communicator threads join-block forever → MAST never retries. Same root as S665454 and S670887.

input.title: ACL access to convert ephemeral app-layer package
input.body: msgr_eng_product_intelligence_temp and videorecs_reels_private_sharing oncalls need ACL access to execute a command to commit in the relevant code path and preserve an ephemeral app-layer package. Currently blocked from completing this step.

ground_truth.root_cause: ACL access not provisioned for the two oncalls to commit in the relevant code path and preserve an ephemeral app-layer package. Oncall (Paul Lu) created and approved ACL tasks T273490223 and T273490053 via MVAI within ~13 minutes.

input.title: Threads U2M retrieval trainer stuck 14 hours — no alert fired
input.body: Model 2124122280 (ig_textpost_feed_u2m_retrieval) trainer hung May 16 04:01 PDT. MAST reported RUNNING, QPS was zero. No alert fired for 14h 9m (last metric sample 04:00:48, next 18:10:23). Manually killed 13 hours later. SJD checks if process is alive, not if it is training.

ground_truth.root_cause: Bug in mvai/light_cli elastic agent: trainer process alive at OS level but Python interpreter stopped progressing; SJD-invisible because SJD checks liveness not training activity. Root cause: elastic agent failed to propagate a non-zero exit code, so SJD did not detect job as stuck. Fix: D98638473.

input.title: ~280 non-actionable example-age dips with UBN/SEV risk per half — planned DPP restarts
input.body: Every ~20 days, DPP automatically restarts each OT job's data session. During the restart, training pauses for a few minutes and example age spikes — often enough to fire UBN/SEV alerts across all OT models. ~280 non-actionable dips per half across 50+ models. Log signature: 'Session <ID> has been running for <N> seconds which is higher than limit: 1728000 seconds. Triggering a new attempt. NOTE: This restart is necessary to prevent the session from running in bad state.'

ground_truth.root_cause: DPP data session TTL of 1728000 seconds (~20 days) expires; DPP automatically restarts each OT job's data session, causing training pause and example age spike. Session restart is necessary per DPP design (Zeus TTL renewal) but lacks a graceful handoff mechanism, generating ~280 non-actionable oncall events per half.

input.title: FBR IFU I2I model 2132070936 missing FULL_SNAPSHOT 8+ hours — reranker model 2125081901 hung since 04:27 PDT
input.body: Model 2132070936 (facebook_reels_ifu_i2i, PROD) has not published a FULL_SNAPSHOT for 8+ hours. Upstream reranker model 2125081901 is hung: MAST reports RUNNING but last mvai_metrics sample was 04:27 PDT, checkpoint 609 stuck in CREATING (size=0) since 04:29 PDT. Process appears alive at OS level — will not self-recover. Downstream T2I update service blocked.

ground_truth.root_cause: Rank 7 of reranker job mvai-training-online-2125081901 hit SIGSEGV in C++ (ServiceRouter stats callback). Elastic agent detected crash but entered D-state (disk sleep / uninterruptible wait) blocked waiting for other ranks to exit cleanly. Zombie job occupied MAST slot indefinitely; downstream 2132070936 FULL_SNAPSHOT blocked for ~28h. Elastic-agent hang (not Python GIL freeze). Mitigated by manual kill; SEV S667567 filed and mitigated.

input.title: Need Help Understanding 0 QPS for Reels models during S660017/S660220 (May 6)
input.body: During S660017 (ZippyDB) / S660220 (Scribe data loss) on May 6, STUS models 2131554922, 877766818, 877767096 had 0 QPS for ~7 hours despite training jobs continuing to run. No new snapshots published, freshness violations resulted. In-trainer MVAI model 877546696 was NOT affected. Asking why only STUS models were impacted.

ground_truth.root_cause: P50: SilverTorch STUS models use the GMPP publisher path (Scribe → ZippyDB for metadata), which was blocked during S660017/S660220. In-trainer MVAI models write directly to model store, bypassing GMPP/Scribe, so they were unaffected. The differential impact is a known architectural vulnerability (P50).

input.title: OT Job logged an error at 11pm, job did not clean up and hung for 11 hours
input.body: MAST job mvai-training-online-2123154171 version 0 attempt 0 logged a failure at 11pm but did not clean up, stalling and logging noise until manually killed 11 hours later. SJD did not detect it as stuck. Issue recurred on mvai-training-online-2123153585. SEV S665478 filed.

ground_truth.root_cause: Elastic agent error handling issue: when the job errored, the elastic agent failed to propagate a non-zero exit code, so SJD did not detect the job as stuck and kill it. Job silently hung logging noise rather than cleaning up. Root cause per Li Lu's analysis P2338625112 — related to P21 elastic agent exit handling.

input.title: Run into two inconsistent metrics for training example age
input.body: Oncall received UBN alert for high training example age on facebook_reels_vdd_hstu_v0 (model 877766932). Two metrics disagree: mvai Scuba shows ~3000 minutes, MAST ODS shows ~2.5 minutes. Alert link: fburl.com/monitoring/dharnxt7. Unclear which metric to trust and why the discrepancy exists.

ground_truth.root_cause: checkpoint_training_data_age_mins derived column fires false positive for OT jobs due to two formula bugs: (1) timezone mismatch — metric_value (UTC) vs train_end_ts after -7h shift via TIME_ZONE_CONVERTER injects systematic error (known bug D75703936); (2) wrong scope — alert designed for recurring training workflows, not OT; train_end_ts is hour-aligned via _resolve_ts_now() for OT, making the derived column architecturally wrong. ODS dpp_worker.scribe_example_age_ms.avg.60 (~2.5 min) is the correct ground truth.

input.title: OT Not Creating New Checkpoints + OP Not Creating New Snapshots
input.body: Two Threads M2M models with OT issues: (1) UserLCE reranker (2124038092): RUNNING but checkpoint age 121h+ (last checkpoint 2026-05-08). (2) VelV reranker (2124047632): RUNNING, checkpoint age ~13h. Consistent failure across 2 regions and 9 restart versions over 21h. GetDataTimeoutError after 6000s. Manually killing and restarting does not resolve.

ground_truth.root_cause: _preload_item_pool() in ig_retrieval/trainer.py blocks the DPP consumer thread during checkpoint loading startup. DPP workers fill output queues while trainer blocks on item pool loading → GetDataTimeoutError after 6000s timeout → crash loop. Model code bug (not infra). Reproducible across 2 regions and 9 restart attempts over 21h.

input.title: The starcart of the online training job did not automatically start the job
input.body: OT job for model 2124118880 (ig_reels_tab_mtml) did not restart after starcart diff was landed. Job status shows online_ready. Model owner manually restarted as workaround; manual restart now shows RUNNING.

ground_truth.root_cause: Model 2124118880 was in ADHOC tier; OT starcart automation only triggers auto-start for models promoted to PROD tier. When starcart diff landed, automation silently skipped OT job creation because ADHOC models are out of scope. Model status showing online_ready misled the owner.
